title: Editor results selection, version 1
description: A release and the result streams that count for it, which scripts/editor-results.py render renders into the release's tables. test/e2e/RESULTS.md describes the rules.

release.description: The release, as its heading in docs/manual-testing.md has it, and as each stream's run-start has it.

streams.description: Each stream that counts for the release, and every file whose name ends in .jsonl in the selection's directory and its subdirectories.

path.description: The stream's path, relative to the selection's directory, without . or .. segments.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the stream's bytes.
